pages.title: Strategy Table
pages.text: A board of hawks and doves, played a thousand times a second: whatever wins more comes back more often.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the share p of hawks and the rounds n. A hawk does better than a dove by (V − pC)/2: the gap must be under the recipe's tolerance (the mix is stable at p = V/C), and the noise of chance, about 1/√n, must be too. More rounds are surer and slower.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Evolutionarily Stable Strategy.
